Question Choices: Fill: A closed right circular cylinder has radius 2 cm and height 8 cm. Find its total surface area. (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ only)
Solution: Include both circular ends and the curved side. Use 2πr²+2πrh. The coefficient of π is 2(2)²+2(2)(8)=40. The total surface area is (40)π square units. Enter only the coefficient: 40.

Question Choices: Fill: A sphere has radius 12 cm. Find its volume. (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ only)
Solution: Use (4/3)πr³. The coefficient of π is (4/3)×(12)³=2304. The volume is (2304)π cubic units. Enter only the coefficient: 2304.
